_about: Readings of National Park Service reports that give the year a later memorial was put up, for memorials the exact-name rule of tests/ext-site-years.mjs cannot reach. Each row is one reading (which sentence says when it was dedicated or dated); the quotation, the page, the heading and the park number are cut from the saved text of the report and are cut again by the builder, which refuses a row that differs.
rule: via "park number": the report's entry carries a park number (MN) and the site gives the same number to a memorial whose name has the unit or the person of the heading in it; the one memorial of that number, of the same kind (monument group, statue, marker), and the sentence names the year of its dedication or installation. via "name": the report prints the site's own name letter for letter with the year in the tag of the entry. A report that numbers or names it differently from the site, a second monument, a replacement, a position marker and a monument without a stated year are left out, with the reason (left).

left.why: the report gives this regiment two dedications (1886; 1888, a larger monument, the old one moved to Hancock Avenue) and the site lists the regiment twice (entry 458, MN 31-C, on the First Day field; entry 460, MN 248, on Hancock Avenue). The report implies that the monument of 1888 stands where MN031-C is and the old one on Hancock Avenue, but no sentence says which of the two entries is which, so neither is given a year

the report gives this regiment two dedications (1886 obelisk; 1888 replacement, the old monument moved to Hancock Avenue) and the site lists the regiment twice (entry 442, MN 47-B, on the First Day field; entry 443, MN 246, on Hancock Avenue). The report implies that the replacement of 1888 stands where MN047-B is and the old one on Hancock Avenue, but no sentence says which of the two entries is which, so neither is given a year

the report's park number MN001 (Cavalry Monument Group, 8th Illinois, dedicated 1891) is the number the site gives to its First Shot Marker (entry 143); the site gives the 8th Illinois Cavalry Monument (entry 144) the number MN 39. The two lists disagree, so neither entry is matched
the report numbers the 2nd Wisconsin monument group MN034-D; the site gives its 2nd Wisconsin Infantry Monument (entry 492) the number MN 35-D. The two lists disagree, so it is not matched
the report says this position (1st Pennsylvania Artillery, Battery B, on Reynolds Avenue) was not marked by the GBMA or the GNPC: there is no memorial
